AlreadyRunning: PitVoice is already running. Look for its icon in the notification area.
ConsoleHostRunning: The PitVoice console host (pitvoice-cli run) is running. Stop it with Ctrl+C and start the app again: one button press must not be executed twice.
game.Connected: running, you are not in the car
ElevationHint: PitVoice does not, so Windows blocks its pit commands and hides keys pressed in the game from the PTT. Start iRacing normally (recommended) or start PitVoice as administrator too. A wheel button PTT is not affected by the second part.
NoPhrasesYet: No phrases yet. Hold the PTT button and say a command.
LanguageNoModel: The speech model of this language is not downloaded.
AssignPrompt: Press the wheel button or the key to use ({0} s, Esc cancels)…
AssignTimedOut: No button was pressed: the button is not assigned, the old one stays.
AssignCancelled: Cancelled, the button stays as it was.
mode.Toggle: Press to start, press again to stop
DeviceMissing: {0} (not connected, the system default is used)
PreviewMuted: The cues are off: the volume is 0%.
PreviewFailed: The output device does not work: {0}
UnitLabel: Fuel unit when the phrase names none
SaveFailed: Settings were not saved to the file ({0}). They apply until you exit.
ModelsIntro: Speech models of every language. The model of the commands language ({0}) is used.
ManifestFailed: The list of models could not be read: {0}
DeleteQuestion: Delete {0}? Phrases cannot be recognized until it is downloaded again.
DeleteFailed: The model could not be deleted, it stays in use: {0}
AdditionsNone: There is no additions file yet. "Open file" creates it with a description of the format.
AdditionsNotApplied: The file has errors and is not used; the built-in words work.
AdditionsMissingWords: These words are not in the speech model and cannot be recognized: {0}
OpenFileFailed: The file could not be opened: {0}
ElidedAction: After "and" the action need not be repeated: "{0}".
BrowserFailed: The browser could not be opened. Copy the address:
CrashMessage: Collect diagnostics and attach the archive to your problem report — it makes the problem easier to find.
DiagnosticsNote: The log holds only what the app does: start, settings, model, game, button and errors. Nothing of your phrases — no audio, no text — is in it. The diagnostics archive holds the logs, crash reports, settings and your command additions; you can open and check it before sending. PitVoice itself never sends it anywhere.
OverlayNote: A small icon above the game shows that PitVoice is listening, recognizing, and how the phrase ended. It is shown only while you are in the car. It is visible over iRacing in windowed and borderless mode only; in exclusive fullscreen Windows does not show it.
OverlayPlaceNote: "Move" shows the indicator even without the game: drag it with the mouse and press "Done" under it. "Move indicator" in the icon menu does the same without opening this window.
